description: Golden fixture for Java 1.17 (M4 version expansion). Reference values are ALGORITHM-DERIVED by the pure-Dart DartWebBackend placement math driven by the Java 1.17 VersionStrategy (legacy pre-cave-and-cliffs ore distribution with copper introduced this release, region-grid salted structure placement, stronghold ring LCG walk, deterministic climate biomes). They are deterministic and self-consistent but NOT externally verified against Cubiomes/Chunkbase; a later live native run should replace them with externally-authoritative coordinates and flip the registry isVerified flag.
